input_and_model: Input-v1, admission-controlled-v1 and synthetic-material-v1 remain unchanged. V3 explicitly represents knowledge completeness/stops and retained safety facts.
representation: Finite full controlled storage alternatives, including rows/fences/expiry, actor sequences and proofs. Whole-state equality deduplicates future-equivalent state, while earlier operation/witness records retain historical Unknown facts.
observation_contract: Only actual retained witness and accepted delivered core results constrain alternatives; injected world_commit, actual injected World/counts/proofs and desired scripted Allowed cannot choose a view.
Unknown retains both commit/no-commit storage possibilities. NoCommitRequested cancellation/failure and guard-memory outcomes do not evaluate/filter hypothetical storage.

Rejected or undelivered reconcile does not narrow views. Delivered exact/missing/expired observations constrain current states without rewriting earlier Unknown history into rollback or a successful receipt.
Unsupported proof alternatives stop with KnowledgeModelIncomplete rather than being discarded. An empty consistent set is InconsistentObservation.
caller.unresolved is operation-scoped, not an aggregate all-operations-resolved assertion. Current state bounds and historical witnesses are distinct.

fixed_model_budgets.reservation: Checked arithmetic before alternative clones. The row/byte envelope includes source states, worst-case successors, two full-state transaction scratch envelopes and 16 DTO slots/16KiB for eight candidates plus eight selected rows.
fixed_model_budgets.not_claimed: These are caller-model accounting limits, not process RSS, actual injected-world, wall-time or full execution-memory guarantees.

stop_contract: Initial state is copied only after reservation; initial stop uses index0 plus phase BeforeInitialState and records no executed command.

A caller-state analysis stop does not rewrite the actual command outcome/witness/receipt or prior modeled facts. Its event has null count bounds/possible_states and knowledge_complete false; no subsequent command runs. Full event/receipt details are serialized only when the evidence budget permits.

Evidence trimming may omit the stopping event or shorten native/compatibility prefixes. Compact first mapping/safety failure and knowledge-stop summaries persist outside event trimming, with incomplete/nonterminal flags; full prior event details are not guaranteed.

Rust compile-time root-only JSON bound covers all simultaneous summaries and maximal valid labels within the unchanged2048-byte minimum. The current initial-stop index is0, already covered by template255.
Incomplete native stopping events do not fabricate Stage1 numeric bounds. Their compatibility entry is omitted, preserving the preceding prefix; trimming respects the shorter compatibility prefix.
oracle_and_regression_source: Independent Python transition predicates, budgets, strict v3 schema and evaluation are synchronized. Source regressions cover Unknown A followed by confirmed B, multiple Unknowns, TTL, delivered/undelivered reconcile, proof ambiguity, whole-state deduplication, resource stops, retained first failures and maximal root size. The possible_states aggregate diagnostic is excluded only from cross-reduction target identity; full per-candidate oracle comparison remains exact.
